narr: On the morning of October 21st a warm front stalled over northern Ohio. This feature brought repeating showers and thunderstorms to the City of Cleveland and surrounding areas. Following a recent wet period, the ground was near saturation and smaller community storm drainage systems were near capacity. Moderate rainfall measuring over an inch an hour. Several road closers and a few water rescues resulted from area flooding.
ev: North Olmsted Police conducted a water rescue along the Rocky River at Cedar Point Road and Valley Parkway in North Olmsted as fast moving hood-deep water surrounded the motorist.
lsr: VALLEY PARKWAY AND CEDAR POINT RD IN ROCKY RIVER RESERVATION CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING. ONE PERSON RESCUED FROM ROOF OF CAR TRAPPED IN MOVING WATER.
